adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both an admin and an owner. Given the variable name and the intended authorization check that follows (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`), this logic will deny access to team admins who are not also owners (unless they are organizer/attendee). This matches the reported 403 scenario and is directly grounded in the diff.
